title: A back in the frame shop window
logline: The empty frame shop's window from the sidewalk, and in the glass a man in plaid from behind looking in — the reflection facing away from us, so the page has a back twice: the man's and the reflection's. The sequence's most careful mirror.

panels.composition: An empty storefront window from the sidewalk with a man in plaid seen from behind standing before it and his reflection in the glass also from behind, the empty shop beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an empty storefront window seen from the sidewalk with a man in blue plaid flannel standing before it seen from behind and his reflection in the glass also showing his back, the empty shop beyond, no words
